purpose: Literature coverage contract for model-health diagnosis and repair. Each row is a source paper, not a claim that the repository reproduces every method on every architecture.

papers.title: Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models through Visual Contrastive Decoding
papers.execution: released tensor-space corruption, plausibility cutoff, and per-token multinomial sampler; POPE uses the paper's T=999 and a clean temperature-one sampling control with the same per-image seed

papers.title: OPERA: Alleviating Hallucination in Multi-Modal Large Language Models via Over-Trust Penalty and Retrospection-Allocation
papers.execution: LLaVA POPE binary specialization of the paper's first-token over-trust penalty; full multi-token beam rollback remains an explicit unsupported route

papers.title: Paying More Attention to Image: A Training-free Method for Alleviating Hallucination in LVLMs
papers.execution: LLaVA eager-attention implementation of the released image-score boost and image-free classifier-free-guidance cache; it remains a native architecture specialization because the source pins a different LLaVA stack

papers.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
papers.execution: label-free visual-search method-family control; official trained SEAL remains separate

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models with Instruction Contrastive Decoding
papers.execution: architecture-native Q-Former disturbance on InstructBLIP, evaluated as a deterministic binary specialization; decoder-input adaptation on Q-Former-free hf_local VLMs is separately labelled adapted

papers.title: ChartQA: A Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts with Visual and Logical Reasoning
MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
HALLUCINOGEN: A Benchmark for Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Visual-Language Models
MLLMs Know Where to Look: Training-free Perception of Small Visual Details with Multimodal LLMs
papers.execution: LLaVA relative-attention ViCrop is an automated L3a FixAgent route with original+crop input; architecture-mismatched models remain explicitly adapted/unavailable

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models with Internal Fact-based Contrastive Decoding
papers.execution: explicit-artifact TruthX contrastive decoder on LLaVA; public Vicuna artifact uses a modern HF post-o_proj hook and is marked adapted, never an exact MSCOCO-editor reproduction
